BASE=main
BODY=$(cat <<'EOF'

Resolves #1310
[View run](https://github.com/The01Geek/prflow/actions/runs/30983414046)

if CREATE_OUT=$(gh pr create --base "$BASE" --draft --title "Bind [[INTERNAL_DOC_LOCATION]] in phase-2 and retrospective skills (#1310)" --body "$BODY" 2>&1); then
  printf '%s\ncreate: ok\n' "$CREATE_OUT"
else
  printf '%s\ncreate: failed\n' "$CREATE_OUT"
fi

ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)
mkdir -p "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp" 2>/dev/null
[ -n "${ZSH_VERSION:-}" ] && setopt nonomatch || :
set -- "$ROOT"/.prflow/tmp/review/*/*/iter-*.json
{ [ -e "$1" ] && printf '%s\n' "$@" | sort; } > "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before" || :
echo "snapshot written"; wc -l < "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before"

ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)
mkdir -p "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp" 2>/dev/null

if [ -e "$1" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$@" | sort > "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before"; else : > "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before"; fi
echo "snapshot written"; wc -l < "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before"

gh pr checkout 1327 ; echo "checkout-rc=$?"
git branch --show-current; git rev-parse HEAD

ls .changeset/; echo "---"; for f in .changeset/*.md; do echo "== $f =="; head -5 "$f"; done 2>/dev/null | head -40

echo "=== checkout-fingerprint.py ==="; scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py 2>&1 | head -20

echo "=== reception-record ==="; scripts/reception-record.py record 2>&1 | tail -20
echo "=== checkout-fingerprint ==="; scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py 2>&1 | tail -12

if [ -n "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" ] && [ -z "${TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID//[0-9]/}" ]; then
